CREATE TABLE nexus.gc_audit ( id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', actor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', dry_run BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, chash_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, chashes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, details JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT gc_audit_pk PRIMARY KEY (id) );
-- Insertion-order read within a tenant (the audit trail). CREATE INDEX idx_gc_audit_tenant ON nexus.gc_audit (tenant_id, id DESC); -- "what happened to THIS collection" — the incident-triage access path. CREATE INDEX idx_gc_audit_collection ON nexus.gc_audit (tenant_id, collection, id DESC);
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.gc_audit CASCADE
